method: Scanned publicly visible post cards and captions, excluded duplicates, non-program personal posts, notices, preparation shots, and visibly mismatched samples; validated image decoding and retained the source URL per card.
limitations: Public mirror snapshot only; does not establish access to deleted/private posts. Visual manual review was sampled, not a separate inspection of each of the 2470 posts. New photographs represent public post covers, not every image in every Instagram carousel.
